## Goal

Make successful product-map publications observable at the public Pages URL, with honest source/version diagnostics.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Push current delivery facts to gcsp-poc and allow Refresh product map inputs and downstream trusted-main Pages deployment to succeed.
2. Inspect successful Pages run42374327870, deployment7621384677 and uploaded artifact13574902456.
3. Read https://garyscarter-ibm.github.io/vehicle-matcher/product-map/data.json using unique query strings and Cache-Control:no-cache.
4. Compare generated_at, ref_snapshot.gcsp-poc and body hashes with the exact uploaded artifact.

## Expected behaviour

The public URL eventually serves the successfully deployed artifact, with a bounded, documented freshness expectation; successful upload/deploy alone is not claimed as public freshness.

## Actual behaviour

At12:51:51UTC on7November2026 the uploaded map was generated from gcsp-poc693844ae9ffbb00763c2a1e50fe35f866176e164. Artifact zipSHA2565adfc251a81d2fcf4f460ac8d73c361f7ace7a90239dd846041e863f8b874d0d; mapSHA2567ed0cc0aef39204e2cdda4e42f18f6e3330f8d7bf909667558532dcf098ecc5a; map549278bytes. Deployment reported success12:52:03UTC and its request used this exact artifact_id.

Public reads through12:59:39UTC still returned548801bytes, generated_at2026-11-07T00:57:38Z and baselinee60c70e6de6a2636750fdf99943e138b89b63932. Independent explicit-IP edge read12:55:59UTC returned the old object with Age0/X-CacheMISS in regionfra, excluding a browser-only/local-cache explanation. Earlier12:42 Pages publication had also succeeded.

## Diagnosis and disposition

Confirmed boundary: generated/uploaded artifact and deployment payload were newer than actual public bytes. Root cause is unconfirmed. Same mainSHA/pages_build_versionce9706ed... across workflow_run publications resembles upstream actions/deploy-pages issue383, but later reports show some same-SHA deployments working; generic deduplication is NOT established. Official v4 action exposes no build-version input. A new main data-only PR34 legitimately mirrors the six canonical Jira records; actual public readback after it is a current workaround/check, not proof that the recurring publication fault is repaired.

Separate stale dev069 imported story facts caused projection conflicts and were reconciled by a guarded six-row data-only commit4f7635afc27a73f0d397659ee8eba992334e0db8. That distinct data condition does not explain old public generation/source bytes.

Medium: misleading delivery progress/freshness; Jira states and application build/live release remain available. Independently deferred under the below-High defect policy. No blocking link, Story acceptance waiver, workflow rewrite, repair or new test execution in this intake.

## Files or areas

.github/workflows/pages.yml; .github/workflows/product-map-refresh.yml; trusted _tools/product_map.py publication inputs; actions/deploy-pages/public Pages serving boundary.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Reproduce or isolate the failed artifact/deployment/serving boundary with exact run/artifact/source identities.
- [ ] Choose a supported publication correction without executing untrusted branch code or bypassing main protection.
- [ ] Demonstrate a later pushed data update is actually served and preserve prior failed observations.
- [ ] Document freshness limits and verify only the affected publication boundary.

## Validate

Future pickup: bounded two-publication readback using small synthetic data and exact artifact/public-body hashes; one worker, no application full suite, provider collection, native PostgreSQL or foreground browser operations. Follow resource/cleanup policy. Current evidence is retained under docs/gcsp/evidence/f58-63-final-publish-actions-2026-11-07/.
